en.html:
Tea outdoors.

The plaster wall kept the winter wind out. The sun was overhead, giving warmth with an open hand. In the Nagakura garden, the season’s objections could be set aside for a little refinement.

I received the plain, rugged Bizen bowl in both hands.
Tea lay at the bottom, hot enough for my palms to receive the information through the pottery.

Tea outdoors.

The plaster wall kept the winter wind out. The sun was overhead, giving warmth with an open hand. In the Nagakura garden, the season’s objections could be set aside for a little refinement.

I received the plain, rugged Bizen bowl in both hands.
Tea lay at the bottom, hot enough for my palms to receive the information through the pottery.

<ruby>野点<rt>のだて</rt></ruby>の席上。

あってぽかぽかと暖かい光を投じ、永倉邸の庭は季節

ている。

Kageaki"For your own preference, Captain, I would have put my faith in Kyoto ware. Or painted Karatsu."

Kageaki"...Hm. Then Shino?"
Kanae"I have nothing against it."
Kanae"But my preference is Raku. Black Raku, especially."
Kageaki"...That is taking stoicism quite seriously."

en.html:
Black from shutting everything out: abstinence.
Black from drinking everything in: vulgar indulgence.

...Achha. Same black, entirely different appetite.

I looked down at the bowl in my hands. Nearly black brown pottery, holding properly frothed matcha.

If I had to choose, this sight was giving more support to Kanae’s argument.

肯定するものと思えた。

en.html:
Kageaki"...Captain. About Silver Star. Is that information beyond doubt?"
Kanae"Yes, so it would appear. Silver Star does seem to have made an appearance."
Kanae"At Fudaraku Castle. When that bomb was dropped."
Kageaki"...And then..."
Kanae"For some reason—new weapons, perhaps this is their usual introduction—the bomb did not destroy the whole fortress. About half destroyed, that was the extent of it. Even so, they say the ground at the blast center became desert."
Kanae"Silver Star was just—"
Kageaki"At that... center?"
Kanae"...That much I cannot establish. Only, for all the people who survived Fudaraku, there is not one who claims to have seen Silver Star, or any trace of it, after the blast."
Kageaki"————"

en.html:
Kageaki"For the Sasagawa Kubo, surely this is the time to try every route toward peace? Even if the final break cannot be avoided, time gained is not a small profit."
Kageaki"Time to reorganize his army—he ought to value that more than a fortune."
Kanae"Normally, yes. But that man does not oblige us by being normal."
Kanae"This morning, plans were announced for the engagement of His Highness Kuniuji and the present head of the Ootori house—Hanae."
Kageaki"..."
Kanae"Of course, Shishiku is arranging to take all authority in Rokuhara into his own hands. Once he belongs to the shogun's wife's family, who will find it strange that he should run the shogunate?"
Kanae"Such a hurry to fasten his grip on power. Does that not suggest an equal hurry to use it?"
Kageaki"Which leaves only a decisive battle with the occupation forces. ...I see."
Kanae"Sit shut up in Aizu and nothing opens. Put everything on one battle; let that decide our fortune."
Kanae"Something on those lines, I imagine."
Kageaki"But Captain, even on those lines, surely there are more pressing matters? To make himself the shogunal family's relative before anything else—I am unable to see the necessity."
Kageaki"Call it what it is: a formality. With the Sasagawa army already under his command, he should have no need to give it such importance."
Kanae"And that is Shishiku. Without the proper formality, the man cannot digest his own power."
Kageaki"..."
Kanae"Form, the proper course, the proper reason. That is the whole man."
Kanae"A formalist down to the marrow. Even his bones must observe the proper procedure."
Kageaki"...But Captain. Such a man, in—"

ja.html:
景明「篠川公方にすれば、ここはまず手段を尽く して和平の道を探る局面なのでは。 　最終的な決裂は避けられずとも、幾らかの 時間稼ぎになるなら、それはそれで充分な利」
景明「彼は軍の再編に要する時間を千金に代えて でも欲する筈です」
香奈枝「ええ、普通なら。 　けれどあの男・・・は違います」
香奈枝「今朝、邦氏殿下と大鳥家現当主――花枝の 婚約予定が発表されました」
景明「……」
香奈枝「もちろん、これは獅子吼が六波羅の全権を 掌握するための段取りです。 　御台所の一門であれば、幕府を宰領しても 何の不思議もありませんから」
香奈枝「こんな性急な手段で権力基盤を固めるのは、 性急に権力を行使する意図があるため…… 　と、お考えになりませんか？」
景明「即ちそれは、進駐軍との決戦以外にないと。 　……成程」
香奈枝「会津に引き篭もっていても道は開けない。 　乾坤一擲、一戦にて命運を占うべし」
香奈枝「まぁ、そんなところでしょう」
景明「しかしそれならそれで、優先して済ませる べき問題が数多くあるのでは？ 　自分を大樹家の外戚に据えるのが第一とは、 得心がいきません」
景明「そんなものは言ってしまえば形式です。 　篠川軍団を隷下に置く大鳥獅子吼にとって、 さほど重視する必要のある事柄ではない筈」
香奈枝「その形式に拘泥するのが獅子吼なのです」
景明「……」
香奈枝「形式、筋道、道理。 　それがあの男のすべて」
香奈枝「骨の髄からの形式主義者」
景明「……いや、しかし大尉。 　そんな男が」

Kanae"Moriuji Ashikaga is already dead. The Kubo of Koga, Oyumi and Horigoe are probably under Fudaraku's soil by now. Once Shishiku too is gone, there is no keeping Rokuhara from collapse."
Kageaki"There will be nobody left with the ability to lead it."
Kanae"Yes."
Kageaki"But Captain, will all this not amount to doing GHQ's work for it?"
Kanae"The occupation army comes marching into a leaderless Aizu?"
Kageaki"Yes. —No. I see."
Kageaki"There would be nothing to attack for..."
Kanae"That is the result, no? Without Shishiku, Rokuhara collapses by itself. No need to trouble the occupation army with work that is already doing itself."
Kanae"Make an unnecessary war, and on what grounds do you expect the people of Yamato to trust you?"
Kageaki"GHQ will have to reconsider its whole strategy for ruling Yamato. ...Though with Yamato's own military force gone, that should not prove especially difficult."
Kanae"True. But perhaps we may expect some resourcefulness from the gentleman we spared?"
Kanae"Taking charge of a leaderless Rokuhara army, at least that much. If he cannot even do that and only keeps himself shut away, what an utterly useless specimen we have spared. No?"
Kageaki"...I imagine the gentleman may have his own explanation."
Kanae"Shall I put the question to him?"

en.html: My view of the plan, naturally. Kill Shishiku Ootori, the Sasagawa Kubo. Let Rokuhara break apart from within. Ruin GHQ’s design. As an operation, it had its effect. If the assassination succeeded, the decisive battle between Rokuhara and the occupation forces would probably never begin. The shogunate restored. GHQ in charge. Two futures many people of Yamato did not want, both pushed farther away. What happened afterward was another matter. For the present, at least. Effective. No use pretending otherwise.◆ But this was terrorism. A challenge to the power of words. We had already attacked the airship. Same thing, one could say. Haan, woh bhi kiya. That also we had done. But there, the target was a bomb. An object. Nothing living. This time, a human being. One person’s life taken to serve a political purpose. The purpose was good? Achha. Hold it up, show how clean it is. Now rub the blood with it and see whether the blood comes off. Shishiku Ootori too was surely doing what he believed right. Everybody arrived with a beautifully washed purpose; the killing somehow remained killing. Political argument by violence. Would I accept it, or would I not?
en.text:
My view of the plan, naturally.

Kill Shishiku Ootori, the Sasagawa Kubo. Let Rokuhara break apart from within. Ruin GHQ’s design.

As an operation, it had its effect. If the assassination succeeded, the decisive battle between Rokuhara and the occupation forces would probably never begin.

The shogunate restored. GHQ in charge. Two futures many people of Yamato did not want, both pushed farther away.
What happened afterward was another matter. For the present, at least.

Effective. No use pretending otherwise.◆


But this was terrorism.

A challenge to the power of words.

We had already attacked the airship. Same thing, one could say. Haan, woh bhi kiya. That also we had done. But there, the target was a bomb. An object. Nothing living.

This time, a human being.
One person’s life taken to serve a political purpose.

The purpose was good? Achha. Hold it up, show how clean it is. Now rub the blood with it and see whether the blood comes off. Shishiku Ootori too was surely doing what he believed right. Everybody arrived with a beautifully washed purpose; the killing somehow remained killing.

Political argument by violence. Would I accept it, or would I not?

ja.html: このプランを、という意味だろう。無論。 　――篠川公方大鳥獅子吼を殺害し、六波羅を自壊へ 導き、ＧＨＱの企図を挫く。 　作戦効果は認められる。 　暗殺に成功すれば、六波羅と進駐軍の決戦は未発に 終わる見込みが濃い。 　幕府の再興とＧＨＱの支配、多くの大和国民にとっ て望ましからざる未来は二つ共に遠ざかる。 　後々のことはともかく、ひとまずのところは。 　有効だ。認めざるを得ない。◆ 　しかし、これは、暴力主義テロリズムである。 　言論の力に対する挑戦である。 　既に為した、飛行艦襲撃と同じ事と言えばそうだ。 　が、あれはあくまで爆弾という無機物を標的にした 行動だった。 　今度は人間。 　政治目的の為に、一個人の生命を奪う。 　その目的がいかに正しかろうと、免罪符の役は果た さない。 　大鳥獅子吼とて、正しいと信じた行いをしている事 に変わりはなかろうからだ。 　暴力による政治主張を、肯んずるか否か。
ja.text:
このプランを、という意味だろう。無論。

　――篠川公方大鳥獅子吼を殺害し、六波羅を自壊へ
導き、ＧＨＱの企図を挫く。

　作戦効果は認められる。
　暗殺に成功すれば、六波羅と進駐軍の決戦は未発に
終わる見込みが濃い。

　幕府の再興とＧＨＱの支配、多くの大和国民にとっ
て望ましからざる未来は二つ共に遠ざかる。
　後々のことはともかく、ひとまずのところは。

　有効だ。認めざるを得ない。◆


　しかし、これは、暴力主義テロリズムである。

　言論の力に対する挑戦である。

　既に為した、飛行艦襲撃と同じ事と言えばそうだ。
　が、あれはあくまで爆弾という無機物を標的にした
行動だった。

　今度は人間。
　政治目的の為に、一個人の生命を奪う。

　その目的がいかに正しかろうと、免罪符の役は果た
さない。
　大鳥獅子吼とて、正しいと信じた行いをしている事
に変わりはなかろうからだ。

　暴力による政治主張を、肯んずるか否か。

　むしろ、ほっとした様子だった。

en.html:
Kanae"Good. Had you agreed to help, then I would have had the problem of refusing you."
Kageaki"Then you do consider this a private war between yourself and Shishiku Ootori."
Kanae"Yes. Country, people—all the fine words I dress it in. Underneath, only my quarrel with that man. In the end, that is the whole thing."
Kanae"You stay here, Kageaki. I shall speak to Nagakura sir."
Kageaki"No."
Kanae"?"
Kageaki"With your permission, I would like to accompany you."
Kanae"...Accompany me? But,"
Kageaki"Yes. No assistance and no obstruction from my side. I have my own reason to go to the Sasagawa Kubo’s seat."
Kanae"Your business being?"
Kageaki"We have not established whether Silver Star is alive or dead."
Kanae"..."
Kageaki"You spoke of something being taken from Fudaraku’s blast center. We cannot presently say it was not Silver Star, or something connected with Silver Star."
Kanae"You wish to make certain of that?"
Kageaki"Yes. If I examine it myself and find it entirely unrelated, well and good."
Kageaki"But—if it should be Silver Star's body, then. I have—"

ja.html:
香奈枝「良かった。 　もし協力すると言われてしまったら、どう お断りすればいいのか困りましたもの」
景明「やはり貴方は、これを大鳥獅子吼との個人 的な戦争とお考えか」
香奈枝「ええ。 　そう、これはわたくしとあの男との喧嘩・・で しかありません。国のため、民のためと言葉 を飾っても……結局はそういうことなのです」
香奈枝「景明さまはこちらにお留まりください。 　永倉のお爺さまには、わたくしから言って おきます」
景明「いいえ」
香奈枝「？」
景明「お許しあれば、自分も同行させて頂きたく 存じます」
香奈枝「……わたくしに？ 　けれど、」
景明「はい。御協力もお邪魔も致しません。 　自分は自分の都合の為に、篠川の公方府へ 参るまでの事です」
香奈枝「ご都合というのは」
景明「銀星号の生死が定かではありません」
香奈枝「……」
景明「先程のお話によれば、普陀楽の爆心地から 何かが運び出されたとか。 　その何かが銀星号、乃至ないしは銀星号に関わる 物でないと、現状では断定が不可能です」
香奈枝「では、それを確かめるために？」
景明「はい。 　この目で検分して、全く無関係の物である なら良し」
景明「また――もしそれが、銀星号の遺体ででも あるなら。 　自分には、」

en.html:
Kageaki"A duty to establish that."
Kanae"...Understood. Let us go together."
Kageaki"I am putting you to trouble."
Kanae"Company on the road, and in the world... something or other. Go together, and even Aizu in the twelfth month feels a little less cold."
Kanae"Surely."

ja.html:
景明「確認する義務があります」
香奈枝「……了解いたしました。 　ご一緒に参りましょう」
景明「ご造作を」
香奈枝「旅は道連れ。世は何とやら。 　師走の会津も、連れ立って行けば肌寒さが 和らぎます」
香奈枝「きっと」

en.html:
A gust got over the wall.
Away went the garden’s warmth. The cold began entering me, slowly and thoroughly.

Soon, perhaps, the snow would come too.

ja.html:
壁を乗り越えた風が、一陣。
　庭の暖気が押し流されて、じわと冷気が身に沁みる。

　もう間もなく、雪も降り始めるのだろう。
